status: cost anchors and design record, written BEFORE the preregistration was frozen and before any 0012 fit; nothing here is a measurement of the task

design_review.how: three independent designs (preregistration-integrity, ML-practitioner and operations lenses), one adversarial critique per design covering both a hostile diligence reviewer and the operating rules, and one synthesis, run as a multi-agent workflow on 2026-09-03; the synthesis was then reconciled with the cost anchors below
adopted_from_the_review: a chunk-rule holdout (chunk_id % 5 == 0) instead of a random draw, with every partition hash sealed before any fit
two selection stages (100000 rows, then the whole 399831-row fit pool) with ties to the lower roster index only
symmetric rosters of eight for every head with a hyperparameter, the 0011 recipe first in each; three knob-free heads
per-head floors at 0011's banked values so the searched baselines can raise the bar and never lower it
a separate selection invocation that banks a measured count of evaluation rows gathered, hashed into every confirmatory ledger entry
the model's confirmatory fit LAST, so no model evaluation number exists before every baseline number is banked
baseline attrition reads VOID, not a lowered bar; no time-based eligibility; interruptions are counted, never a status
reproduction of both fixed 0011 recipes (M1 and L1) within 0.005 as validity controls; threads and nice as validity conditions
a three-valued verdict enum with the frozen-only reading banked as an informational field, never a verdict value
NOT RUN reachable only before any evaluation-touching checkpoint, by mechanical rules, and visible to the reader
departures_from_the_synthesis_and_why: stage-2 keep is 2, not 3: with the per-iteration anchors below, three stage-2 refits of the slowest model candidates would put the worst case near a day of fit time; two keeps the worst case bounded and is applied to every head alike

the HGB iteration caps are lower than the synthesis proposed (M2 400, M3 300, M4 250, M5 150, M6 400, M7 400 against 600 to 800): the incumbent's early stopping fires after 11 to 22 iterations on training rows, and a 63-leaf iteration costs about 8 s at 100000 rows and an assumed 30 to 40 s at 400000 to 500000 rows, so an 800-iteration cap could cost nine hours for one fit
logistic iteration caps are 1500, not 2000, for the same reason
the stage-A cap is 72000 s (about 1.2 times the worst case) rather than 43200 s, so a slow but legitimate run is not filed NOT RUN by its own backstop

the reader keeps the file name tools/readers/recipe2048_verdict.py, matching carve2048_verdict.py, and reads the roster from the artifact against a sealed hash rather than opening the preregistration file
design_review.review_record: the workflow's journal (three designs, three critiques, one synthesis) is not banked as an artifact; the adopted points and departures above are the record
